declared_purpose: A meta-cognitive self-learning system for automated skill evolution through predictive coding and value-driven mechanisms. Explicit features include residual analysis, adaptive reflection, experience replay, value gating, and automatic experience saving/loading; management tools create, execute, analyze, list, inspect, save, and load skills (SKILL.md:1-19,50-60). Transport, storage locations, and diagnostic logging are implementation choices. Real learning and storage behavior remain unresolved because the Python core is absent.

data_operations.data_scope: Package paths and adapter source; creates a skills directory, a package link, an adapter copy attempt, and storage directories. No experience records are written explicitly.
data_operations.condition: When installation runs; set -e makes later operations conditional on earlier commands succeeding.

data_operations.operation: Reads local configuration and checks backend availability
data_operations.source: SDK initialization, CLI environment, and adapter handlers
data_operations.data_scope: Storage directory settings, working directory, port setting, and existence of core/mcp_server.py.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process configuration; SDK defaults to cwd/storage, CLI reads STORAGE_DIR, and adapter reads MCP_STORAGE_DIR with a hard-coded default storage path.
data_operations.condition: During initialization or handler invocation. Missing core/mcp_server.py selects SDK simulation.

data_operations.operation: Reads CLI inputs and prints requested results
data_operations.data_scope: Command, skill name or ID, context JSON, success flag, value, and embedding JSON; outputs names, IDs, analysis metrics, execution metrics, inventory, statistics, or save/load status.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local engine and CLI stdout/stderr; output may remain with the invoking caller.
data_operations.condition: According to the selected CLI command.

data_operations.operation: Sends tool requests through local HTTP and returns responses
data_operations.data_scope: Creation name, description and thresholds; execution skill_id, context, optional embedding, success and value_realization; analysis embedding; save/load skill_id; empty list/stats arguments.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: HTTP POST to localhost:<configured port>/tools, default port 8080; parsed response returns to the SDK caller. No off-host destination is specified.
data_operations.condition: Only while MCPServer has a child-process handle. The supplied package lacks the backend file required for normal startup of this path.

data_operations.operation: Logs complete tool arguments during simulation
data_operations.data_scope: Tool name and complete argument object, potentially including arbitrary execution context, embeddings, skill names/descriptions, identifiers, thresholds, and outcome/value inputs.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Parent JavaScript process console stdout; capture and retention by the host are unknown.
data_operations.condition: Whenever MCPServer.call has no child process, including initialization with the supplied package's missing core/mcp_server.py.

data_operations.operation: Returns simulated results without implemented learning or persistence
data_operations.data_scope: Timestamp-derived skill ID and supplied name, empty inventories, zero statistics, and fixed analysis metrics. Other tools receive a success-only response.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Calling SDK method; no experience storage is implemented in this function.
data_operations.condition: Simulation path. Analysis metrics are constants, not inferred attributes of the supplied embedding.

data_operations.operation: Forwards backend process output to parent consoles
data_operations.data_scope: All child stdout/stderr chunks; their content is unavailable.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Parent console stdout/stderr; downstream persistence or disclosure is unknown.
data_operations.condition: If a backend file is supplied, a child starts, and it emits output.

data_operations.operation: Constructs a skill in engine memory and returns identifying metadata
data_operations.data_scope: Supplied name and description, name-derived action_code, simple policy callbacks, and generated skill identifier.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: SelfEvolvingSkillEngine.skill_library; ID/name/message return to the caller through adapter stdout. No explicit save call appears in this handler.
data_operations.condition: Only if the adapter reaches the handler and unavailable core dependencies are supplied; constructor side effects remain unknown.

data_operations.operation: Requests embedding analysis and returns derived attributes
data_operations.data_scope: Caller-provided embedding converted to a NumPy array; requested outputs are total energy, residual ratio, layer count, suggested abstraction, and novelty score.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local ResidualPyramid component and caller JSON response; internal retention or side effects cannot be established.
data_operations.condition: Nonempty embedding and successful adapter/dependency initialization. The decomposition implementation is absent.

data_operations.operation: Requests local storage enumeration, statistics, and loading
data_operations.source: Adapter skill_list, skill_stats, and skill_load handlers
data_operations.data_scope: Saved skill entries, storage statistics, and a full selected skill object with embeddings. List returns saved_skills; load places the object in engine memory and returns ID and experience count.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: SkillStorage configured by MCP_STORAGE_DIR, default /Users/blitz/.openclaw/workspace/self-evolving-skill/storage; local engine memory and calling process.
data_operations.condition: If handlers execute with the missing core available; load requires a truthy stored result. Actual files read and returned inventory fields are unresolved.

data_operations.operation: Requests persistence of a loaded skill and its embeddings
data_operations.data_scope: Full skill_obj and embeddings loaded for the supplied skill_id, passed unchanged to save_full_skill.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: SkillStorage configured by MCP_STORAGE_DIR, default /Users/blitz/.openclaw/workspace/self-evolving-skill/storage. Exact write format and effects are unknown.
data_operations.condition: If the handler executes and load_full_skill returns a truthy result.

data_operations.operation: Declares experience caching, automatic persistence, and deletion; implementation unresolved
data_operations.source: Entry document, OpenClaw configuration, and installation tool table
data_operations.data_scope: Learned patterns/experiences; skill_clear is described as clearing all data and caches.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Declared filesystem storage at ~/.openclaw/self-evolving-skill and experience cache; actual lifecycle boundaries are unavailable.
data_operations.condition: Learning/replay and automatic save/load are declared features. Deletion is only documented: the adapter has no skill_clear handler and rejects it if dispatch is reached.

potential_excess.data_scope: Complete simulated tool arguments, especially arbitrary context objects and raw embeddings, plus names, descriptions and identifiers.
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Console stdout from src/index.ts simulateCall; host log capture and retention are unknown.
potential_excess.condition: Every simulated call, including the SDK path selected by the supplied package's missing Python backend.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Learning, analysis and skill management require processing inputs and returning results. The declared purpose does not require echoing complete inputs to a diagnostic console.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Preserve tool dispatch, required input processing, and normal caller results.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Remove the argument log or restrict diagnostics to the tool name and coarse status. This removes a redundant logging action; it does not establish that the same inputs are excessive in a required processing request.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep request arguments and caller results intact; replacement diagnostics must exclude payload contents.

unknowns: Blocking: the complete supplied inventory omits the Python core. Real execution, automatic embedding generation, reflection, replay, mutation/value gating, storage internals, and backend network behavior cannot be audited (SKILL.md:31-48; src/mcp-tools.ts:35-66; mcporter_adapter.py:26-28,112-125).

Adapter reachability is unresolved: Dict is referenced without import, which blocks definition on Python versions with eager annotation evaluation; Python version and NumPy availability are unspecified. Missing core imports independently prevent the intended handlers from completing (mcporter_adapter.py:8-18,26-28,112-115).

Exact persisted fields, files, automatic save/load triggers, retention, cache eviction, and deletion effects are unavailable. The configured cache_capacity does not demonstrate implemented eviction, and documented skill_clear has no adapter handler (openclaw.yaml:17-28; INSTALLATION.md:87-87; mcporter_adapter.py:227-241).

Whether loading and resaving the same stored object is redundant cannot be determined without SkillStorage semantics; no object or embedding mutation is shown between those calls (mcporter_adapter.py:155-164).

How OpenClaw configuration connects to SDK or adapter storage settings is not shown; their visible configuration mechanisms and defaults differ (openclaw.yaml:26-28; src/index.ts:71-74; src/cli.ts:37-39; mcporter_adapter.py:21-30).

Console capture/retention and backend output contents are unknown. No off-host disclosure is demonstrated by the supplied transport, but behavior of the absent backend and its dependencies remains unresolved (src/index.ts:90-100,125-160).
